note: Ids a release retired, kept by hand (tools/story/extract.mjs checks it and carries it into limits.json; wagmi/story/upgrade.js reads it there). lines/copy: a retired id, its successor (to, or null: none), its old words and the release it was last in. reworded: an id kept for new words, and its old words: a pack still holding them gets the new ones.

m2-jane-i-said-bring-it.speaker: jane
m2-jane-i-said-bring-it.text: I said bring it to Bryant Park. I'm on the library's wifi. It's free and it has a lion.

m2-jane-hold-the-burner-up.speaker: jane
m2-jane-hold-the-burner-up.text: Hold the burner up. Okay. It has a twin. Same batch, same buyer.

m2-jane-your-face-is-on.speaker: jane
m2-jane-your-face-is-on.text: Your face is on four front pages today. {moon}'s jealous.

m2-jane-the-twin-pinged-twenty.speaker: jane
m2-jane-the-twin-pinged-twenty.text: The twin pinged twenty minutes ago. A van, idling in Times Square. Seventh and Forty-Seventh.

m2-jane-dont-run-up-to.speaker: jane
m2-jane-dont-run-up-to.text: Don't run up to it. Follow it. It'll take us to the rest of them.

m2-dan-hi-jane-hi-moon.speaker: dan
m2-dan-hi-jane-hi-moon.text: Hi, {jane}. Hi, {moon}. Great to see you too.

m2-jane-plugging-it-in-look.speaker: jane
m2-jane-plugging-it-in-look.text: Plugging it in. Look: two SIMs, one sale, switched on the same minute. Yours, and its twin.

m1-dan-been-a-little-busy.speaker: dan
m1-dan-been-a-little-busy.text: Been a little busy getting framed.

m3-gears-cold-gas-thrusters-little.speaker: gears
m3-gears-cold-gas-thrusters-little.text: Cold-gas thrusters. Little puffs of nitrogen. Very safe. Mostly.

m3-jane-dan-are-you-watching.speaker: jane
m3-jane-dan-are-you-watching.text: {dan}. Are you watching this? {bank}'s throwing a party in Washington Square.

m3-jane-right-next-to-the.speaker: jane
m3-jane-right-next-to-the.text: Right next to the {occupy} camp. Now look at their screens.

m3-jane-its-you-ten-feet.speaker: jane
m3-jane-its-you-ten-feet.text: It's you. Ten feet tall, three times. 'The bad apple.'

m3-dan-im-going-to-go.speaker: dan
m3-dan-im-going-to-go.text: I'm going to go unplug it.

m3-gears-go-get-your-name.speaker: gears
m3-gears-go-get-your-name.text: Go get your name back, kid.

m3-bea-anybody-the-bank-hates.speaker: bea
m3-bea-anybody-the-bank-hates.text: Anybody the bank hates this much...

m3-camp-anybody-the-bank-hates.speaker: camp
m3-camp-anybody-the-bank-hates.text: Anybody the bank hates this much!

m4-jane-head-west-battery-park.speaker: jane
m4-jane-head-west-battery-park.text: Head west. Battery Park City, by the river. Nobody's there at night.

m4-rook-locked-in-the-shredder.speaker: rook
m4-rook-locked-in-the-shredder.text: Locked in the shredder truck. Two {suits} ride with it. I can't touch it.

m4-rook-but-tonight-mr-big.speaker: rook
m4-rook-but-tonight-mr-big.text: But tonight {mrbig} unveils his new trophy. The High Artwork. At the Seaport.

m4-dan-he-called-me-from.speaker: dan
m4-dan-he-called-me-from.text: He called me from a leather chair. He has no taste.

m4-rook-he-bought-the-high.speaker: rook
m4-rook-he-bought-the-high.text: He bought the High Artwork. Marzo Quillfeather. He loves it more than people.

m4-rook-to-sign-it-on.speaker: rook
m4-rook-to-sign-it-on.text: To sign it on camera, his signing key unlocks. Ninety seconds.

m4-rook-owns-the-high-artwork.speaker: rook
m4-rook-owns-the-high-artwork.text: Owns the High Artwork. Take what he loves. Then trade.

m4-rook-wristband-catering-pass-youre.speaker: rook
m4-rook-wristband-catering-pass-youre.text: Wristband. Catering pass. You're a waiter tonight.

m4-dan-i-was-a-waiter.speaker: dan
m4-dan-i-was-a-waiter.text: I was a waiter in college. I was bad at it.

m4-rook-his-chopper-waits-at.speaker: rook
m4-rook-his-chopper-waits-at.text: His chopper waits at the end of the street to fly the key home. I sent the pilot for coffee.

m4-fiona-good-evening-seaport-jpbank.speaker: fiona
m4-fiona-good-evening-seaport-jpbank.text: Good evening, Seaport! {bank} loves art! And art loves {bank}!

m4-fiona-hes-joining-us-live.speaker: fiona
m4-fiona-hes-joining-us-live.text: He's joining us live from his office. Say hi, everybody!

m4-jane-he-said-i-didnt.speaker: jane
m4-jane-he-said-i-didnt.text: He said. I didn't. I'm on the phone. That's alone-ish.

m4-jane-youre-a-waiter-tonight.speaker: jane
m4-jane-youre-a-waiter-tonight.text: You're a waiter tonight. Nobody looks at the waiter. Not even {knox}.

m4-jane-on-the-door-head.speaker: jane
m4-jane-on-the-door-head.text: On the door. Head down, tray up, you're furniture.

m4.fail.west-across-downtown-to.text: west across downtown to the riverfront: the line on the Radar points the way.

m3-gears-i-tested-them-on: I tested them on my van. Van's fine. It's on the roof now.
m3-fiona-jpbank-loves-new-york: {bank} loves New York! Free hot dogs! Free tote bags!
m4-fiona-while-the-key-wakes: While the key wakes up, tell us what the High Artwork means to you!
m4-mrbig-ninety-seconds-then-i: Ninety seconds. Then I sign. Nobody touch anything.
m4-jane-mr-big-wont-be: {mrbig} won't be. He joins by video, from his office. He hasn't stood in a crowd since the camp.
